mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prd_patch (id, prd_id, source, source_finding_id, source_version_id, base_draft_revision, scope, operation, target_block_id, source_quote, new_content_markdown, reason, status, created_by, created_at, session_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{prdId}, #{source}, #{sourceFindingId}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{baseDraftRevision}, #{scope}, #{operation}, #{targetBlockId}, #{sourceQuote}, #{newContentMarkdown}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, now(), #{sessionId})
mapper.sql: p.id, p.prd_id, p.source, p.source_finding_id, p.source_version_id, p.base_draft_revision, p.scope, p.operation, p.target_block_id, p.source_quote, p.new_content_markdown, p.reason, p.status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.applied_at, p.session_id, p.applied_revision, (SELECT f.title FROM review_finding f WHERE f.id = p.source_finding_id) AS finding_title, (SELECT f.severity FROM review_finding f WHERE f.id = p.source_finding_id) AS finding_severity
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM prd_patch p WHERE p.prd_id = #{prdId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM prd_patch p WHERE p.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF p

SELECT FROM prd_patch p WHERE p.prd_id = #{prdId} AND p.status = 'APPLIED' AND p.applied_revision <= #{revision} AND p.applied_revision > (SELECT patch_checkpoint_revision FROM prd_document WHERE id = #{prdId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prd_version_patch vp WHERE vp.patch_id = p.id) AND COALESCE( p.applied_revision > (SELECT v.draft_revision FROM prd_version v WHERE v.prd_id = #{prdId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1), p.applied_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.created_at) FROM prd_version v WHERE v.prd_id = #{prdId}), '-infinity'::timestamptz)) ORDER BY p.applied_revision, p.id

SELECT
FROM prd_patch p WHERE p.source_finding_id = #{findingId} AND p.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE prd_patch SET status = #{status}, applied_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPLIED' THEN now() ELSE applied_at END, applied_revision = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPLIED' THEN (SELECT revision FROM prd_document WHERE id = prd_patch.prd_id) ELSE applied_revision END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
